sections.name: Everyday Glow
sections.description: Skin-first looks: glowing complexion, defined brows, a little warmth.

looks.title: Skin-First Glow
looks.text: glowing, even complexion with a skin-tint, a touch of golden highlight on the cheekbones, brushed-up brows, clear gloss over a brown lip liner

looks.title: Bronze Everyday
looks.text: soft bronze shimmer on the lids, brown pencil tightline, a sweep of warm terracotta blush, nude-brown satin lip

looks.title: Brown Liner and Gloss
looks.text: barely-there base, defined brows, a deep brown lip liner blended inward under a glossy clear top

looks.title: Honey Glow
looks.text: honey-gold highlighter on the high points, sheer warm-brown lids, mascara, caramel lip gloss

looks.title: Cocoa Matte
looks.text: matte complexion, cocoa-brown eyeshadow blended into the crease, soft brown liner, matte chestnut lip

looks.title: Peach-Brown Flush
looks.text: sheer peach-brown blush on the cheeks and lids, glossy lashes, a tinted lip balm in a warm brown-rose

looks.title: Fresh Freckles
looks.text: glowing skin with soft drawn-on freckles across the nose, clean brows, glossy nude-brown lip

looks.title: Espresso and Gloss

looks.title: Terracotta Sunset
